title: GTA 6 won't name names in politics, says Rockstar 🗳️
subject: gta6
description:
Do you want GTA 6 satire to go further? 👇

In LOVE Magazine issue 27, out October 5, 2026, Rockstar narrative SVP Rupert Humphries said GTA 6 avoids being too specific about any real person, event or movement, and exaggerates culture wars in Leonida instead. GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Sources: LOVE Magazine issue 27 via VGC (Oct 5, 2026), GTA BOOM
Game images © Rockstar Games.

scenes.text: Rockstar says GTA 6 won't name names in politics.
In LOVE Magazine's new issue, narrative boss Rupert Humphries said they don't want to be too specific about any person, event or movement.
Instead, Leonida gets exaggerated culture wars, with election signs, campaign robocalls and political radio.
The idea: push an issue until the ridiculousness becomes clear, and hopefully funny.
And Jason and Lucia's American Dream is small: a paid-off home and a stable family.
